title: Argentinian Lentil Bowl
description: A hearty and flavorful bowl filled with argentinian-style lentils, served with a side of sautéed vegetables.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic, cook until softened (3-4 minutes).
Add red bell pepper and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add lentils, cumin, and chili powder. Stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until lentils are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro.
Serve over a bed of light, fluffy rice or enjoy as a standalone bowl.
